target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/budget-utm-framework-current.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-budget-program
checks: Guest boot and desktop startup passed; graphical keyboard focus and input were confirmed.
Budget form creation, entry save/reopen, edits, cancellation, abort, and clean exit passed.
The saved transaction remained visible after a cold disk-only reboot.
The guest accepted 40+2 as 42 after recovery and reported zstatus failed=0.
limits: This is a headless QEMU probe using UTM's bundled QEMU framework, not a test in the live UTM window. It does not resolve the user's earlier live UTM Budget freeze report or establish Pi behavior.
